description: This file defines API routes for managing videos in a FastAPI application, including listing videos, retrieving details, uploading new videos, and streaming video content. It interacts with storage services, handles metadata, and provides functions for file management and data retrieval.

methods.name: Optional[int] _parse_id_from_stem(stem: str)
methods.description: Parses leading numeric ID from filename stem.

methods.name: int _hash_id_for_file(path: Path)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic positive ID from filename using CRC32.

methods.name: dict _read_json(path: Path)
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON metadata from a file, returns empty dict on failure.

methods.name: None _write_json(path: Path, data: dict)
methods.description: Writes a dictionary as JSON to a specified file.

methods.name: tuple[Optional[datetime],Optional[datetime]] _fs_times(p: Path)
methods.description: Retrieves creation and modification timestamps of a file.

methods.name: List[SubtitleOut] _collect_subtitles_for_video(video_id: int, request: Optional[Request])
methods.description: Collects and returns list of SubtitleOut objects for a given video ID.

methods.name: list_videos( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )
methods.description: Lists available videos, optionally filtered by search query.

methods.name: Optional[Path] _resolve_video_path_by_id(video_id: int, vids_dir: Path)
methods.description: Resolves a video file path by ID, using filename pattern or hash.

methods.name: get_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific video, including subtitles.

methods.name: upload_video( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles uploading a new video and creates associated metadata.

methods.name: stream_video( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Streams video content with support for HTTP Range requests.

ctags.name: FPath
ctags.pattern: /^from fastapi import APIRouter, File, HTTPException, Path as FPath, Query, UploadFile, Request$/

ctags.name: get_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video"), request: Request = None, )

ctags.name: iter_file
ctags.pattern: /^    def iter_file(start: int, end: int) -> Iterator[bytes]:$/

ctags.name: list_videos
ctags.signature: ( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional search string to filter by title"), )

ctags.name: stream_video
ctags.signature: ( video_id: int = FPath(..., description="ID of the video to stream"), request: Request = None, )

ctags.name: upload_video
ctags.signature: ( title: str = Query(..., description="Title for the uploaded video"), description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional description"), file: UploadFile = File(..., description="Binary video file to upload"), request: Request = None, )
